headline: Inside Microsoft's Giant Outlook Outage
summary: Microsoft suffered a nearly 24-hour Outlook outage, impacting global users. The incident affected businesses, governments, and employees. It is described as one of Microsoft's worst historical outages.

headline: DOJ and Commerce Depts Investigating Megaspeed
summary: The DOJ and Commerce Departments are investigating Singapore-based Megaspeed. This probe follows Megaspeed's ties to Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's resignation. The departments clarified the ongoing investigation after earlier reports of a halt.

headline: Study: School Phone Bans Improve Kids' Learning
summary: A new nationwide study found in-school cellphone bans lead to modest learning improvements. Researchers will now examine phone use outside school and its link to learning loss. This follow-up study will use conditions from Meta's multibillion-dollar settlement.

headline: Jensen Huang Willing to Return as Nvidia CEO
summary: Former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang expressed willingness to return if the company's board desires it. He resigned last week, prompting an outpouring of support for his return. Huang cited calls from employees, investors, and partners.

headline: GTA 6 Lucia Actress Finally Revealed
summary: The actress portraying Grand Theft Auto 6's main character, Lucia Caminos, has been revealed. This long-anticipated announcement comes right before the game's launch. The revelation confirms widespread fan speculation.

headline: Kevin Smith on Marvel/Star Wars 'Hope Assembles' Crossover
summary: Writer Kevin Smith discusses the unprecedented 'Star Wars/Marvel: Hope Assembles' crossover. The comic brings together two massive pop culture juggernauts. Smith explains how these unlikely universes collide in the story.

headline: French Sci-Fi Classic 'TER' Debuts in English
summary: Magnetic Press is bringing the French sci-fi comic classic 'TER' to American audiences. This marks the first English language translation of the acclaimed work. The release introduces a new readership to the modern classic.

headline: Jensen Huang Open to Returning as Nvidia CEO
summary: Former Nvidia boss Jensen Huang is ready to return as CEO if the board asks. His previous resignation was amidst a scandal involving alleged infidelity and espionage. Huang co-founded the company and expressed his willingness to lead again.

headline: Milburn's Neets Report: Key Proposals
summary: A major review by Milburn proposes widespread changes for young people. The report aims to help 'Neets' (Not in Education, Employment, or Training) find work. Proposals focus on improving employment opportunities across the UK.

headline: Jensen Huang Pushes Nvidia Comeback
summary: Jensen Huang is advocating for his return as Nvidia CEO. This push follows the board reportedly rejecting initial pressure to reinstate him. Huang claims an 'outpouring' of support from investors and others for his comeback.

headline: Crimean Bridge Collapses After Ukraine Attack
summary: A section of Russia's strategic Crimean Bridge has partly collapsed following a Ukrainian attack. President Zelensky hailed the 'unprecedented' strike, which took weeks to plan. The bridge is a vital link between Russia and annexed Crimea.

headline: BBC Reports from Kyiv Bridge After Russian Attack
summary: BBC's Sarah Rainsford reported live from a Kyiv bridge hit by a Russian attack. She spoke to residents near the site of the overnight strike. The report provided eyewitness accounts of the aftermath in the Ukrainian capital.
